question: India launched chip-enabled biometric e-passports in __________ cities as of April 2025.
solution:
The correct answer is __**13 cities**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• **India launched chip-enabled biometric e-passports** to enhance security and reduce the risk of passport forgery and identity theft.
 
• As of **April 2025**, these e-passports have been issued in **13 cities**, ensuring better accessibility for citizens across major urban centers.
 
• These e-passports use a **secure microchip** embedded in the passport, which stores essential data such as personal details and biometric information, making them tamper-proof.
